from datetime import datetime

def get_release_month(title, artists_str):
    # Search by song title
    results = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=title, page_limit=20)
    if not results:
        return None
    
    # Build expected artist set
    expected_artists = set(a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(','))
    
    for song in results:
        song_artists = set(a['name'] for a in song['artists'])
        if song['title'] == title and expected_artists == song_artists:
            release_date = song['release_date']
            # Parse date and format as MM/YYYY
            dt = datetime.fromisoformat(release_date.replace('Z', '+00:00'))
            return dt.strftime('%m/%Y')
    
    return None

# Test on Silver Lining
print(get_release_month('Silver Lining', 'Ava Morgan'))
